text: Every time I get a large fries at this location, they always fill it halfway.   Why is that?  I pay extra to get a large size so I expect to get it filled to the top.  It's like they're doing it on purpose.  I might as well just get the medium because that's essentially the size you get, except you pay extra for no reason.  The girl working on the fries has a horrible attitude as well.  She gave me cut eye when she handed me my bag.  If she doesn't want to work there then find another job, don't cheat customers out of their money because you don't enjoy working there.  I purchased my order on Friday February 27th at 8:00pm.  Please speak to that employee, she needs to be trained on customer service and how to fill the fries orders properly.
author: Logan Moy

text:
Maria seriously needs to go. If this is the kind of attitude you’re okay with, don’t be surprised when this store shuts down soon.

The way she talks to customers is completely messed up. Zero professionalism, zero civic sense, and the constant bully faces? This is F&B, not a high school hallway.

You’re not doing anyone a favor by serving food — we’re paying for it. That includes proper service and basic respect. No one is going to spend their hard-earned money just to be treated like trash.

And let’s talk about hygiene — walking around with open hair in a food place? That’s just careless and unacceptable.

Fix this immediately, or you’re going to keep losing customers.
author: Kaushik Dey

I  come here every single day  simply because I use the app on my break for it to be quick  and every single day they manage to mess up my order if not things being Not the right items then it’s them forgetting something and then instead of apologizing as someone in customer service would I’m here getting laughed at they’re here finding it amusing that an order was messed up. text:
Safety Hazard - Served Rotten Food & Zero Management Response
​I am extremely disappointed with this location. I ate an apple slice packet here on an empty stomach and became ill with food poisoning symptoms without eating anything else in +-2 hours. Upon inspection, the remaining apples were clearly rotten.
​Despite contacting support and the store manager—and following up multiple times—I have been met with total silence. It’s clear that customer safety and basic communication are not priorities here. Avoid this location if you value your health.
author: Kathy

text: The service I received yesterday was one of the worst. My day end coffee is usually pretty good but for some reason the employee who served me decided to hate on me for asking for a napkin. I'm pretty sure if you hand me a pastry you should give out a napkin. I believe that there are employees under mining this McDonald's for some reason. It only takes one bad apple to spoil the hole bunch. So if you don't like your job leave we the paying customer don't need your drama and the work place doesn't need hate.
author: Jimmy Croaker

text: 30 minutes d’attente car l’employé n’a pas vérifié les tickets lors de la distribution des commandes, et quelqu’un a pris la mienne. J’ai dû attendre qu’ils refassent tout. De plus, la pelle à nuggets est tombée par terre dans la cuisine. Les employés ont hésité à la remettre à sa place au lieu de la laver. Voyant que des clients les observaient, ils ont finalement décidé de la mettre à l’arrière. Bref, service déplorable et hygiène douteuse. Passez votre chemin c'est cher pour rien
author: Maxime

I was there to order and she said 10 times we r closing in 2 mins and when i placed a order and asked if its chicken or bacon she made irritated faces and said its crispy and had unhygienic appearance- open hair roaming around near the food department she is crazy,i would rate it zero throw her out.

text:
Made a takeout order on Sunday. I placed it a couple minutes before close. Noticed that my burger had a weird texture. So when I looked, the meat was raw.

I teared it in half to see what the rest of the burger looked like, and it was raw all the way through. Since the store was already closed, they said they couldn’t do anything before they turned off all of the equipment.
author: Marvin D.L
